news.title: Russian Oil Exports by Arctic Route Jump Amid World Freight Crisis
news.summary: Russia's oil exports through its Northern Sea Route (NSR) in 2026 have already exceeded last year's by nearly 50%, with some 20 million barrels shipped to Asia from the start of navigation in July to mid-October, traders said and data showed.
